# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Blog entry renderer with basic XSS protection. """ import html from typing import Final # Example template; in a real project this would come from a config or # template engine. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Format a blog entry for safe display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The main body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the HTML representation of the post, with all user-supplied content properly escaped to avoid XSS and other injection attacks. Notes ----- * The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralise any HTML entities that could be interpreted by the browser. * It also removes potential script tags that might slip through by escaping them. The template does not use any `unsafe` rendering features, so the result is safe to inject directly into a page. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("text must be a string") # Escape user input to neutralise HTML special characters safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Render the final HTML return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
